content.text:
=== enabled OpenCulturas/geocoder modules ===
=== HTTP check via ddev exec curl ===
localhost: HTTP 301
<title>Redirecting to http://localhost/en</title>

observation.command:
cd /workspace
echo "=== enabled OpenCulturas/geocoder modules ==="
runuser -u dev -- ddev drush pm:status -y --fields=name,enabled,status 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "openculturas|geocoder|leaflet|smart_date" | head -15
echo "=== HTTP check via ddev exec curl ==="
runuser -u dev -- ddev exec curl -s -o /dev/null -w "localhost: HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost/
runuser -u dev -- ddev exec curl -s http://localhost/ | grep -oE "<title>[^<]*</title>" | head -2
